Chapter 1280: 30: It'S Enough

Chapter 1280: Chapter 30: It’s Enough

Lin Yuan gazed at the avatar before him.

The avatar shared the same mental will as the true self, but lacked the strength of the original form. Why was this?

Firstly, because there wasn’t much mental will invested in the avatar.

Secondly, the avatar’s physical form was casually condensed, unable to exhibit Lin Yuan’s true strength.

In comparison, a clone’s strength is much superior because its physical form has been cultivated and is strong enough.

Whether in the Chaos Void, the first source world, or the second source world, cultivators highly regard clones, especially the main battle physical forms.

The loss of a main battle physical form wastes years of effort.

As of now.

The avatar casually condensed before Lin Yuan hadn’t undergone any cultivation.

Yet, due to the utilization of the Rune Dao, this avatar’s strength underwent a qualitative change, reaching a level close to the Abyss Dragon.

“Even with just an avatar now, my strength can rival the Eternal Son of the second source world?” Lin Yuan marveled.

What is the Eternal Son?

It is an existence cultivated by a great sect, even highly regarded by the Eternal Lord before its final emergence.

Its strength far exceeds that of the Strongest Venerable of the first source world.

The Master of Wushan, through his drawing skills, created three perfect giant paintings, with the strong ones within barely reaching the threshold of the Abyss Dragon for the first two paintings.

Has such fighting strength now been reached by Lin Yuan’s casually condensed avatar?

“The strength of the true form?”

Lin Yuan perceived his own changes.

An enhanced understanding of the Rune Dao allowed him to utilize the Rune Dao more perfectly, whereas the thirteenth tier legacy “Infinite Void” merely enhanced his inner universe.

Now, the Rune Dao’s enhancement for Lin Yuan is comprehensive, ranging from the inner universe, to the physical body, soul, and mental will, including everything.

“This is only the initial comprehension of this legacy.”

Lin Yuan composed himself. The legacy created by the Lord of Heaven Light mainly elaborated on the comprehension of runes.

According to the Lord of Heaven Light’s division, the legacy is divided into five levels. Comprehending the fifth level allows one to utilize the power of runes within the time cycle.

Lin Yuan has currently only comprehended the first level.

Of course, Lord of Heaven Light frankly acknowledged that it was unrealistic for normal cultivators to comprehend the fifth level, which was nearly at the Eternal Lord’s level of perception.

However, even reaching the third or fourth level can provide ample aid to break through the time cycle, where comprehension regarding runes, even if not directly utilized, can be slightly used indirectly.

“Unfortunately, even now, compared to the thirteenth level time life, the gap is still significant.”

Lin Yuan pondered; the strength of thirteenth level time life lies in their ability to glimpse future timelines.

The choices for the future outweigh direct strength.

Even disregarding this ability to observe future timelines.

Lin Yuan was far from being a match for thirteenth-level life.

“Take it slowly.”

“With this legacy, the chance to break through the time cycle seems much greater.”

Lin Yuan felt pleased. The Lord of Heaven Light considered it unrealistic for cultivators to master the fifth level of the legacy.

However, for other cultivators.

Lin Yuan certainly wasn’t in this category.

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, truly exerting himself to comprehend.

Not to say he could certainly train to the fifth level, yet there was a significant hope.

Perception at the Eternal Lord’s level? Lin Yuan was not incapable of reaching this, it was merely a matter of how much time and energy he would devote.

…

At the edge of the Chaos Void.

A rift connected to a dimension beyond.

A giant eye looked from afar.

It was the Eye of Myriad Laws.

“This dimensional rift…” The Eye of Myriad Laws scrutinized it closely.

The Chaos Void wasn’t perfect; even with numerous time lives filling in, dimensional rifts still occurred at its edges.

Dimensional rifts connect to dimensions beyond, which are dimensional gaps.

Dimensional gaps, already detached from the dimension where the Chaos Void resides.

There, dangers abound but also contain numerous opportunities.

The dimensional rift locked by the Eye of Myriad Laws is connected to a dimensional gap containing resources it requires.

To obtain such resources, the Eye of Myriad Laws utilized accumulated favors to send over a dozen Invincible Great Saints.

Whoosh!

At this moment.

A figure condensed, forming a silver-robed elder.

“Myriad Laws Senior.”

The silver-robed elder, named Great Saint Feng Zhu, was an Invincible Great Saint. He received the Pavilion of Myriad Laws’ protection during his weaker years, thus owing a favor to the Eye of Myriad Laws.

“How is it?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Great Saint Feng Zhu and inquired.

“Beyond the dimensional gap, the native creatures on the small continent are too difficult to deal with, making it challenging to claim the Magic Origin Fruit,” Feng Zhu said honestly.

The Magic Origin Fruit, a dimensional treasure, drifts in dimensional gaps, absorbing some ‘laws’ of dimensions it approaches.

Hence, the Magic Origin Fruit itself contains fundamental laws of different dimensions.

Such a treasure significantly replenishes the Eye of Myriad Laws.

Naturally, around where the Magic Origin Fruit grows, dimensional creatures often emerge.

Dimensional creatures are born within dimensional gaps, endowed with innate strength.

Furthermore, outside the dimensions, the Invincible Great Saints from the Chaos Void can’t exert significant strength.

Unable to leverage the Chaos Void’s power.

Therefore, despite the Eye of Myriad Laws inviting over a dozen Invincible Great Saints to obtain the Magic Origin Fruit.

They still faced immense resistance.

“As long as the Magic Origin Fruit can be obtained, I will express my gratitude profoundly,” the Eye of Myriad Laws told Great Saint Feng Zhu.

“Since the Myriad Laws Senior says so, I will surely exert all my efforts,” Feng Zhu nodded.

Eye of Myriad Laws has gone through numerous cosmic eras, its promises of gratitude would even appeal to Invincible Great Saints.

At this moment—

Buzz~

A subtle wave slowly transmitted from outside the dimensional gap.

The previously fixed dimensional rift began to slowly shrink.

“Not good.”

“It’s the dimensional tide.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws’ gaze slightly changed.

Dimensional rifts in the Chaos Void cannot persist indefinitely.

They will occasionally restore or appear, affected by external environmental influences.

Currently, a dimensional tide has arisen, impacting this dimensional rift, and it is about to completely close.

“Trouble.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu’s expression darkened.

Once this dimensional rift before their eyes closes and heals, the time needed for this area to reopen a dimensional rift again is unknown.

A thousand cosmic eras?

Ten thousand cosmic eras?

It’s all possible.

By that time, Great Saint Feng Zhu was estimated to have already reached the thirteenth tier.

Compared to Great Saint Feng Zhu, Eye of Myriad Laws was equally anxious.

Regardless of how long the Cosmic Era might last, Eye of Myriad Laws could wait.

However, Eye of Myriad Laws could not guarantee whether the Magic Origin Fruit would still be here the next time this dimensional gap opened.

The Magic Origin Fruit drifted between different dimensions; if missed this time, it was likely to drift far away, and Eye of Myriad Laws would practically lose the opportunity to obtain it.

“The dimensional gap will take time to heal even if it closes, roughly three days before it fully heals.”

Eye of Myriad Laws carefully observed, then looked at Great Saint Feng Zhu, “As long as we pick the Magic Origin Fruit within three days.”

“Three days?”

Great Saint Feng Zhu naturally understood what Eye of Myriad Laws meant.

“Impossible.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu shook his head, “That small continent has only been explored to its outskirts, and merely bypassing the dimensional creatures on the outskirts is difficult enough. To reach the core area and pick the Magic Origin Fruit within just three days and then retreat safely… I can’t do it.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu said.

It’s not a matter of cost.

It’s simply impossible.

“I understand.”

Eye of Myriad Laws was silent for a moment, also recognizing that picking the Magic Origin Fruit within three days was unreasonable.

“Magic Origin Fruit…”

Eye of Myriad Laws looked at the dimensional crack again, which was shrinking visibly.

“Forget it.”

Eye of Myriad Laws made a decision in his heart.

…

In a certain desolate void.

Lin Yuan’s true self sat cross-legged, following the drift of Chaos Qi.

At this moment.

The Power of Space-Time converged to form a gigantic eye.

“Eye of Myriad Laws?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Eye of Myriad Laws and said casually, “What do you want from me?”

The connection with Eye of Myriad Laws ran deep, so he was not surprised that the other could find him.

“Great Saint Galaxy.”

Eye of Myriad Laws showed a humble demeanor, unlike when dealing with Great Saint Feng Zhu.

“There is something I want to ask for your help with,”

Eye of Myriad Laws said.

“Speak.”

Lin Yuan looked at Eye of Myriad Laws.

Moments later.

“You want me to go outside a dimensional gap and retrieve that Magic Origin Fruit?” Lin Yuan understood Eye of Myriad Laws’ intention.

“Yes.”

“That Magic Origin Fruit is very important to me.”

Eye of Myriad Laws nodded.

Retrieving the Magic Origin Fruit within three days was an impossible task even for an exceptional Great Saint.

After much thought, Eye of Myriad Laws believed only Lin Yuan had a chance to complete this task.

A short time ago, Lin Yuan had exhibited his power, being acknowledged by Eye of Myriad Laws and other special entities as the strongest among the invincible Great Saints in history.

“You need to think clearly.”

Lin Yuan looked at Eye of Myriad Laws with a calm tone, “At that time, you spread the Martial Arts Evolution Road offshoot for me, in exchange for asking me one favor in the future.”

“Are you sure you want to use that request for this?”

Eye of Myriad Laws, upon hearing this, fell into thought once again.

Actually, the most valuable approach to this request is to wait until Lin Yuan steps into the thirteenth tier to make it.

But who knows if Lin Yuan will ever reach the thirteenth tier? If he doesn’t, wouldn’t it be a waste? There are many invincible Great Saints throughout history, but very few have ultimately become time lifeforms.

And right now, that Magic Origin Fruit is crucial to Eye of Myriad Laws.

Missing this opportunity would mean losing the chance.

“Great Saint Galaxy, I’m sure.”

After careful consideration, Eye of Myriad Laws replied earnestly.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He then asked, “What is the situation outside the dimensional gap?”

“Pretty dangerous. Even for a normal invincible Great Saint, retrieving the Magic Origin Fruit within three days is very difficult.”

Eye of Myriad Laws explained truthfully.

In this aspect, he dared not hide anything.

“Is there a thirteenth tier existence?”

Lin Yuan asked differently.

“A thirteenth tier existence?” Eye of Myriad Laws was slightly taken aback.

“No.”

Eye of Myriad Laws responded immediately.

What a joke?

A thirteenth tier existence?

If there were a thirteenth tier existence beside the Magic Origin Fruit, no matter how much he desired it, he wouldn’t dare have any thoughts.

Moreover,

near the Chaos Void, the appearance of a thirteenth tier lifeform would inevitably be noticed by the time lifeforms within that Chaos Void.

“Absolutely not.”

Eye of Myriad Laws assured Lin Yuan.

He thought Lin Yuan was worried he was being led to certain death.

“I understand.”

Lin Yuan nodded and said, “I will dispatch a clone to enter that dimensional gap and retrieve the Magic Origin Fruit for you.”

“Thank you, Galaxy…”

Eye of Myriad Laws was about to express gratitude.

Suddenly, he froze.

A clone… a single clone?

“Great Saint Galaxy, the situation outside the dimensional gap is still very dangerous. Can just sending a clone suffice?” Eye of Myriad Laws cautiously inquired.

Eye of Myriad Laws greatly acknowledged Lin Yuan’s strength.

Believing him to be the strongest invincible Great Saint in history.

But just a single clone?

“It’s enough.” Lin Yuan glanced at Eye of Myriad Laws.

Now, a single clone of his could exhibit strength akin to the Abyss Dragon, and all the invincible Great Saints in the history of Chaos Void combined probably couldn’t defeat one of his clones.

Moreover, Lin Yuan’s true self continued to oversee the situation.

Lin Yuan was indeed anticipating who, with his current strength, could possibly obstruct him if the thirteenth tier time lifeforms don’t appear.

Even if the mysterious dimensional gap really harbors an opponent equal to himself?
